profile.headline: Graphic Designer, Web Designer, Social Media Expert, Entrepreneur & Investor
profile.summary:
"Transformational Creative Leader | 16+ Years of Experience
As a seasoned creative designer with a passion for innovation, I bring over 16 years of experience working with top-tier production firms and music production companies. With a diverse skill set and entrepreneurial spirit, I'm driven to make a meaningful impact by crafting groundbreaking ideas that inspire and captivate audiences.

Key Expertise:
Graphic Design
Web Design
Motion Graphics
CGI Artistry
Video Editing
Coding
Business Ownership

Let's collaborate to bring visionary ideas to life!"

positions.title: President/CEO
positions.description:
Founded in 2006 by President and CEO Jason D. Jones, Advent Studios is a pioneering digital media company renowned for crafting breathtaking, state-of-the-art digital imagery.
Our Expertise

We specialize in delivering exceptional visual content for:
Websites
Films
Digital Advertising
Social Media Marketing
Technical Software Solutions

In addition to our creative services, Advent Studios provides innovative technical software solutions tailored to the visual effects and animation industry, empowering professionals to push the boundaries of digital storytelling.
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Project Management · Paid Social Media Advertising

positions.title: CONTENT SPECIALIST, WEB AND GRAPHIC DESIGNER AND MARKETING
positions.description:
E-commerce Expert & Digital Marketing Strategist
Spearheaded comprehensive e-commerce solutions and digital marketing initiatives, driving business growth and online success.

Key Responsibilities:
Content Strategist: Developed innovative promotional ideas for social media, web blogs, and online advertisements.
Shopify Project Manager: Oversaw web development, graphic design, and e-commerce projects from concept to launch.
E-commerce Product Development: Created new product categories, listings, and optimized product content for maximum visibility.
Marketplace Management: Successfully managed product uploads, pricing, and inventory across Amazon, eBay, and Wayfair platforms.
Shipping and Inventory Management: Utilized Stamps.com and QuickBooks to streamline shipping operations and maintain accurate inventory levels.
Targeted Marketing: Executed targeted advertising campaigns using Google Ads, Instagram, and Facebook to drive conversions and boost brand awareness.

positions.title: Graphic Web Designer
positions.description: Content Strategist in developing new ideas for promotions on social media, web blogs and ads

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
A Strategic Hiatus
I made the deliberate decision to take a temporary break from my full-time role, allowing me to focus exclusively on nurturing my entrepreneurial ventures. This intentional pause enabled me to concentrate on developing my business and cultivating my online publication, setting the stage for future growth and success.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Engaged in a seasonal contract role to transform an existing prescription drug website, elevating its online presence through a professional redesign and implementation of a Content Management System (CMS).

Key Objectives:
Revamped outdated website design to enhance user experience and credibility
Implemented a robust CMS solution, utilizing platforms like WordPress and Joomla
Streamlined content management and editing capabilities for effortless updates and maintenance

Deliverables:
A modern, visually appealing website design
Seamless integration with a user-friendly CMS
Enhanced website functionality and performance
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Typography · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Web Applications · Web Design

positions.title: Motion Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Editing, Compositing, and Motion Graphics Designer (2008-2009)
Utilized expertise in video editing, compositing, and motion graphics design to deliver high-quality visual content for various clients.

Key Responsibilities:
Assembled and input raw footage into computer systems for editing and post-production.
Synchronized and stored uncut rushes and sound files, ensuring seamless integration into final projects.
Re-ordered and refined content to achieve logical sequencing and smooth playback.
Collaborated with the Creative Division to design graphics for prominent TV shows, including Tempo News, Live and Direct, and Badness Outta Style, using industry-leading software such as Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Illustrator, and 3D Studio Max.

Motion Graphics and Animation Expertise:
Created stills, over-the-shoulder graphics, and animations for broadcast in 27 Caribbean countries.
Assisted the Creative Director in developing graphics for live production environments.
Contributed significantly to shaping the overall look and feel of commercials and animations.
Designed and animated motion graphics commercial reels for various music artists, ranging from 15-second to 30-second spots.

3D Design and Visual Effects:
Modeled organic characters, hard surface models, props, and backgrounds using polygonal, NURBS, and sub-division topologies.
Textured, rigged, animated, and simulated dynamics for 3D models.
Lit and rendered 3D scenes for final output.

Client Portfolio:
Worked with various recording labels and music artists to deliver high-quality visual content.
positions.insights: Skills: Motion Graphics · Graphic Arts · 3D Modeling · Autodesk 3ds Max · Video Editing

positions.title: 3D Modeling and Graphic Design
positions.description:
3D Modeling & Animation Expert (2005-2008)
Served as a key team member, supporting the Creative Director in a fast-paced live production environment, designing and delivering high-quality graphics for directorial review.

Key Achievements:
Designed and animated national broadcast commercials for web and television platforms.
Developed 15-30 second motion graphics reels for top music artists.
Specialized in 3D architectural design and visual effects, bringing concepts to life.

positions.title: Animation Specialist
positions.description: Assistant to the Creative director in charge and helping create the graphics in a live production environment to be sent to the director.
